description: React component code for a defect detail page within a quality defect tracking system. It manages defect details, images, and corrective actions including CRUD operations and status toggling.

methods.name: asId
methods.description: Converts a string or string array parameter to a numeric ID type.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches defect details and associated corrective actions from the API and updates state.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Confirms and deletes the defect, then redirects to the defects list.

methods.name: onCreateAction
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new corrective action for the defect.

methods.name: toggleDone
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a corrective action.
